name: Tax Filing Assistant
description: Prepare federal income taxes — PDF document ingestion, calculation, form generation, and guided filing. Federal returns only (no state). Supports 1040, Schedules 1/C/D/SE, Form 8889, Form 8863, and common credits. 2024 + 2025 tax years.
author: Crow

env_vars.name: CROW_TAX_DB_PATH
env_vars.description: Path to tax data database (defaults to Crow's main DB)

env_vars.name: CROW_TAX_ENCRYPTION_KEY
env_vars.description: Passphrase that encrypts personal data at rest (SSN, names). Choose your own and keep a copy: without it saved returns can't be read. Changing it keeps the old one in CROW_TAX_ENCRYPTION_KEY_PREVIOUS (when that is empty), so returns saved with it stay readable.

env_vars.name: CROW_TAX_ENCRYPTION_KEY_PREVIOUS
env_vars.description: Only after changing the passphrase: the old one, so returns saved with it can still be opened. Each return moves to the new passphrase when the tax server next starts or the return is saved; then this can be cleared.

notes: Federal returns only — no state income tax support. Supports MFJ, Single, HoH filing. 2025 tax year. Generates filled IRS PDFs ready to mail and step-by-step guided filing instructions. PII is encrypted at rest. Not a substitute for professional tax advice.
